insights:
DeepSeek led a broad price cut, with DeepSeek V4 Flash 0423 down 73% from $0.457 to $0.121 — the steepest drop of the day. A cluster of frontier and mid-tier models followed at roughly 65-70%: MiMo-V2.6-Pro down 70% to $0.177, Claude Fable 5.1 (max with fallback) down 69% to $7.17, and Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol (max) and Muse Wonder (max) each down 68%, landing at $2.94, $1.47, $1.47 and $2.94. Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and GPT-5.6 Terra (max) fell 67% to $1.74, o3 dropped 61% to $1.55, and Kimi K3 (max) slipped 54% to $2.31.

Not everything fell. Ling-3.0-flash-VL rose 190%, from $0.035 to $0.100, and dropped out of the top 10. Qwen3 Coder Next climbed 64% to $0.570, DeepSeek Pro Latest 54% to $2.82, and Z.ai GLM 5.1 38% to $2.28.

The notable new entry is Agnes 2.5 Pro Beta at $0.057 with intelligence 35.2. Claude Opus 5.5 (max with fallback) slid from #5 to #8, while Granite 4.2 3B, Ling-3.0-flash-Fin and Qwen3.5 4B entered the intelligence frontier.
